svg.text: BioSeeki: a project-centered desktop research workspace
Local research context, connected scientific tools and traceable outputs
Adaptive work with task state and checkpoints
Files, indices, memory and outputs are managed locally
Evidence and researcher oversight travel with the work
A shared project continues across research sessions
Shared project files + task state + knowledge + memory
